value.rationale: The naturally distinct axis-reflection classes of generalized Mycielskians of the smallest even cycle with an edge-axis three-orbit quotient have completely different homotopy types at every depth. One is contractible, the other has three-periodic topology with exponentially growing free integral sphere multiplicities. This resolves an intrinsically motivated infinite family of geometric fixed points, beyond the earlier nonequivariant ambient classification; not an arbitrary one-off census or known table recomputation.
